metadata.title: Block Kit messages aren't truncated to Slack limits → oversized content is silently rejected (HTTP 400)
metadata.description: buildItemBlockKit and buildDigestBlockKit built section text and header text fields without enforcing Slack's hard Block Kit limits (section text.text <= 3000 chars, header text <= 150 chars). A long --text note, a long close reason, a long item title/header, or a long digest item title produces a block over the limit, so Slack rejects the ENTIRE message with HTTP 400. On the afterCommand hook path the rejection is swallowed (logged to stderr only), so notifications silently vanish. Fix: add a truncate(text,max) helper that appends an ellipsis when cutting, and apply it to every section text (cap 3000) and header text (cap 150) in both builders.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.acceptance_criteria: section text capped at 3000 and header at 150 with an ellipsis indicator; normal content unchanged; unit test proves limits are enforced

metadata.title: Close/block Slack reasons always show 'no reason given' (data-shape mismatch)
metadata.description: Symptom: Slack close/block notifications always read 'Reason: no reason given' even when a reason was provided. Repro: PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK set; pm close <id> --reason 'x' (or pm update <id> --status blocked --blocked-reason 'y'); inspect built message. Observed: 'Reason: no reason given'. Expected: 'Reason: x' / 'Reason: y'. Root cause: hook read camelCase item.closedReason/blockedReason but pm emits snake_case close_reason/blocked_reason. Fix: PmItem now includes close_reason/blocked_reason; buildCloseMessage/buildBlockMessage prefer snake_case then fall back to camelCase. Proven via runtime probe: CLOSE now shows real reason, BLOCK shows real reason, minimal item still null-safe.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed: read snake_case close_reason/blocked_reason (with camelCase fallback); verified via runtime probe with real result shapes.
